title: Multiple subjects, occlusion, and explicit performer selection

fixturePolicy.references: licensed or synthetic two- and three-subject images with partial occlusion and background entanglement
fixturePolicy.selection: a machine-readable selected-subject description and confidence must precede bible generation
fixturePolicy.attempts: record provider/model/prompt hash/seed/request id/retry reason for every generation

assertions: Low-confidence or ambiguous subject selection blocks generation instead of guessing.
Unselected people, limbs, clothing, and background features do not leak into the chosen character.
Occluded body regions are explicitly designed and evaluated rather than silently copied or truncated.
Identity and selection evidence remain bound to the chosen source bytes.

releasePolicy.reason: Selection safety and generated identity require human review.
